posts.title: Alice in Wonderland, All the Way to CS312 — Part 1
posts.description: I have recently been working through Stanford's deep learning CS31 and plan to discuss my reasoning and rationale on the questions of the the quizzes and One of the Question of the quiz asked us to predict what happens to a transformer's validation loss when different architectural components are removed. I initially underestimated how important residual connections are relative to normalization.
